profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): found this rows Intergate brand name belongs to Sabey Data Centers, not Digital Realty, matched an exact Building 4 designation to a specific address under Sabey, and corrected the top level operator field accordingly, preserving Digital Realty as former_operator per this registrys standard policy.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, recorded in this registry as a Digital Realty facility named Intergate Seattle East Building 4 in Tukwila, WA, is a significant correction rather than a simple address add. Intergate is Sabey Data Centers own registered campus brand, not Digital Realtys, and this operators own confirmed current Seattle area facility is separately branded SEA1, not Intergate. A datacenterHawk listing titled Sabey Data Centers Intergate.East Building 4, an exact match to this rows own Building 4 designation, gives 3433 South 120th Place, Tukwila, WA, and independently agreeing PeeringDB and DataCenterJournal listings confirm Sabey as the operator of this same Intergate.East campus. This session found no record of Digital Realty ever having acquired this specific Sabey campus, so this may represent either a past genuine change of operator this session could not further document, or an original labeling error in this registry, rather than a confirmed acquisition. Per this registrys standard ownership change policy, the top level operator field on this row was updated from Digital Realty to Sabey Data Centers, with Digital Realty preserved as former_operator rather than deleted, and ownership_verified_on set to todays date. The rows own name still reads Intergate Seattle East Building 4 and was left unchanged, since it already correctly reflects the Sabey brand.

profile.facility_type_note: The Westin Building at 2001 Sixth Avenue, downtown Seattle (Digital Realty's SEA10), is one of the most important internet exchange and carrier hotel buildings on the US West Coast, historically known as the Westin Building Exchange. Digital Realty acquired a controlling stake in the building, per Data Center Frontier and Commercial Property Executive coverage of the transaction. The Intergate facility in Tukwila is a separate building from the downtown Westin Building; Digital Realty also operates a facility (SEA1) at 3433 S 120th Place in the Seattle/Tukwila area per datacenterHawk.
